steps.title: Strict Mode & Defensive Shell Scripting
steps.description: Initialize a production-grade Bash script implementing unofficial strict mode (`set -euo pipefail`) and custom exit traps.
tasks: Add a trap function `cleanup` that echoes 'Cleaning up temporary buffers' on EXIT signal (`trap cleanup EXIT`)

verification.command: test -x /home/student/strict_deploy.sh && grep -q 'set -euo pipefail' /home/student/strict_deploy.sh && grep -q 'trap' /home/student/strict_deploy.sh && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: CLI Argument Parsing with getopts
steps.description: Write a dynamic CLI utility script that parses command line flags (`-e <env>`, `-p <port>`, `-v` for verbose).
tasks: Implement `while getopts "e:p:v" opt; do` loop handling arguments
Store the environment in an `$ENV` variable and port in `$PORT`

verification.command: test -x /home/student/cli_parser.sh && grep -q 'getopts' /home/student/cli_parser.sh && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: High-Throughput Log Filtering with awk and sed
steps.description: Generate a sample web access log and build a single-line pipeline extracting HTTP 5xx error rates per client IP.
tasks: Create a sample log at `/home/student/access.log` containing 20 lines of simulated Nginx logs with mixed 200, 404, and 500 status codes
Write a parser script `/home/student/parse_errors.sh` that uses `awk` to filter lines where status code >= 500
Output the count of 5xx errors to `/home/student/5xx_report.txt`

verification.command: test -f /home/student/access.log && test -x /home/student/parse_errors.sh && /home/student/parse_errors.sh && test -f /home/student/5xx_report.txt && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Automated Health Monitor Daemon with Lockfile
steps.description: Create a daemon script that uses a PID lockfile (`/tmp/health_monitor.lock`) to prevent duplicate overlapping runs and monitors disk/memory thresholds.
tasks: Check if `/tmp/health_monitor.lock` exists before running; exit with status 1 if locked
If not locked, create the lockfile, write current PID `$$`, log system date & uptime to `/home/student/system_health.log`, and remove lock on exit

verification.command: test -x /home/student/health_daemon.sh && /home/student/health_daemon.sh && test -f /home/student/system_health.log && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Rotating Archive & Backup Engine
steps.description: Build an automated backup script that compresses `/home/student/app` into timestamped `.tar.gz` archives and purges backups older than 7 days.
tasks: Create workspace directory `/home/student/app` with sample config and source files

verification.command: test -x /home/student/backup.sh && /home/student/backup.sh && ls /home/student/backups/*.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Process Signal Trapping & Graceful Shutdown
steps.description: Create a long-running service script that gracefully handles `SIGTERM` and `SIGINT` signals, flushes buffers, and exits with 0.
tasks: Register `trap 'echo Gracefully stopping service; exit 0' SIGTERM SIGINT`

verification.command: test -x /home/student/graceful_service.sh && grep -E 'trap.*SIGTERM|trap.*SIGINT' /home/student/graceful_service.sh && echo PASS || echo FAIL
